scope: General educational worry-organising activity, not diagnosis, treatment or a validated intervention. Existing instruments, scoring and safety routes are unchanged.
method: AI editorial source comparison, contextual eight-language copy review and automated browser checks. Not independent clinical or human native-speaker review; no clinical-effectiveness or real-user outcome evidence.

sources.usedFor: Separate concerns that allow practical action from those that cannot be resolved now; allow pausing and returning attention to the present. No guarantee of symptom relief.
Choose a manageable practical step; consider timing and help; review or reduce the step. The short activity does not reproduce a treatment programme.
Optional onward link to the official stress self-help guide catalogue, which lists all eight supported languages. Sunrain prompts are its own educational summary, not official translated guide text.
sources.limits: Direct PDF retrieval failed: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Spanish returned 403; Japanese, Hindi and Arabic timed out; Korean returned a redirect failure. PDFs were not read, mirrored or represented as reviewed. The accessible catalogue is the linked destination.

privacy.focusAndPart: Optional public example choices remain in page memory; no private concern text is requested. Explicit preparation can copy these choices into the existing contact-record field.
privacy.plan: Reuse the existing three optional action/timing/help fields and original worry/check-in-worry storage keys and version. Never load or save automatically. Explicit save/download excludes the two focus choices.
privacy.reset: Clears only this activity’s choices, feedback and three unsaved plan fields. Separate contact drafts and explicitly saved device notes are retained; their existing delete controls remain available.
privacy.navigation: Refresh, language switch, navigation away and persisted browser-history return clear unsaved state. No health content is placed in URLs or requests.

localeReview.en: Plain optional language; waiting, tasks and caring examples avoid assumptions about employment, family structure, age or a national health system.
localeReview.zh-hans: Short fragment headings omit terminal full stops; questions retain full-width marks. Uses 学习、工作、待办 and 可信任的人 rather than assuming a parent or employer is safe.
localeReview.zh-hant: Uses 回覆、學業、資訊、計畫、儲存、裝置 and 選填; does not equate Traditional Chinese with Taiwan or Hong Kong.
localeReview.es: Uses paired question marks, consistent informal tú and broadly understandable studies/tasks/caring examples. Does not assume Spain or access to its health system.
localeReview.ja: Uses polite, non-demanding optional forms, short headings and school/work/errand examples. No gender, employment or household assumptions; no changes to Japanese instrument availability.
localeReview.ko: Uses consistent polite guidance, fragment labels without sentence periods and 학업·일·처리해야 할 일. Practical help can come from a trusted person or service, not necessarily family.
localeReview.hi: Uses Devanagari prose punctuation, concise labels and respectful optional phrasing. Avoids gendered first-person examples and does not assume Hindi means India.
localeReview.ar: Uses Modern Standard Arabic, Arabic question marks and RTL layout. Uses gender-neutral first-person uncertainty where feasible; no country, religion or family-support assumptions.

independentReview.remainingLanguageLimits: AI editorial checks cannot establish native idiom, dialect preference or culturally representative lived experience. No human native-speaker review has occurred.

helpEntryRecheck.limits: Read entry-page information only; no booking, phone contact, acceptance, cost, response time or current appointment availability was tested. The runtime catalogue's previous check date is not silently refreshed.

regions.GB-ENG: Official NHS entry read: England route and age limits are service-specific; existing youth support retained.
regions.US: FindTreatment root did not expose useful text; SAMHSA search information indicates US/territory scope, but direct official explanatory pages returned 403. Full service/language recheck remains incomplete; no catalogue claim expanded.
regions.JP: Official Ministry of Health directory read. Interface languages include Japanese, English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese and Korean; individual provider language must be confirmed separately.
regions.KR: Official Korean mental-health institution directory read. Regional/type search in Korean; no new phone or service-availability claims added.
regions.ES: Official registered-health-centre directory read. Directory access does not establish an appointment or provider eligibility.
regions.HK: Hospital Authority specialist outpatient instructions read, including referral and document requirements. No fee, booking or service-language guarantee added.
regions.CN-BJ: Single hospital's official booking instructions read. Remains explicitly a Beijing provider, not national coverage.

helpEntryRecheck.coverageGaps: Hindi-speaking and Arabic-speaking regions are not covered merely by providing those interface languages. Keep explicit region selection and local primary-care/public-health fallback; do not invent contact details.
